title: Distress, urgency & safety
goal: Recognise Mayday, Pan-Pan and Sécurité, log the radio traffic with the time, and answer a Mayday on the radio.

l26-01.text: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday. This is fishing vessel Cap Béar, Cap Béar, Cap Béar. Mayday, Cap Béar. Position three five fifty-four North, zero zero five forty-two West. Taking water in the engine room. Require immediate assistance. Four persons on board. Over.
l26-01.es: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday. Aquí el pesquero Cap Béar, Cap Béar, Cap Béar. Mayday, Cap Béar. Posición tres cinco cincuenta y cuatro Norte, cero cero cinco cuarenta y dos Oeste. Hacemos agua en la sala de máquinas. Necesitamos asistencia inmediata. Cuatro personas a bordo. Cambio.

l26-02.text: Diego, the log. Write down the time.
l26-02.es: Diego, el libro. Anotá la hora.

l26-03.text: Nineteen eighteen. Mayday received. Written, Chief.
l26-03.es: Diecinueve dieciocho. Mayday recibido. Anotado, jefa.

l26-04.text: Cap Béar, this is Tarifa Traffic. Received Mayday. A Salvamento Marítimo boat is on its way. ETA forty minutes. Over.
l26-04.es: Cap Béar, aquí Tarifa Tráfico. Recibido Mayday. Una embarcación de Salvamento Marítimo va en camino. Llegada estimada cuarenta minutos. Cambio.

l26-05.text: Captain, we're only six miles from that position.
l26-05.es: Capitán, estamos a solo seis millas de esa posición.

l26-06.text: Then we go. Tanya, call Tarifa Traffic. Diego, keep the log: every call, with the time.
l26-06.es: Entonces vamos. Tanya, llamá a Tarifa Tráfico. Diego, llevá el registro: cada llamada, con la hora.

l26-07.text: Tarifa Traffic, Tarifa Traffic, this is LNG Horizon, LNG Horizon. Received Mayday from Cap Béar. We are six miles from the position. Proceeding to assist. ETA thirty minutes. Over.
l26-07.es: Tarifa Tráfico, Tarifa Tráfico, aquí LNG Horizon, LNG Horizon. Recibido el Mayday del Cap Béar. Estamos a seis millas de la posición. Vamos a asistir. Llegada estimada treinta minutos. Cambio.

l26-08.text: LNG Horizon, Tarifa Traffic. Thank you. Proceed to the position and report when on scene. Over.
l26-08.es: LNG Horizon, Tarifa Tráfico. Gracias. Diríjanse a la posición e informen al llegar. Cambio.

l26-09.text: Tarifa Traffic, Cap Béar. The water is rising. We are preparing the liferaft. Over.
l26-09.es: Tarifa Tráfico, Cap Béar. El agua sube. Estamos preparando la balsa. Cambio.

l26-10.text: Tanya, rescue boat crew to stand by. Pilot ladder ready on the starboard side.
l26-10.es: Tanya, la tripulación del bote de rescate en espera. La escala de práctico lista por estribor.

l26-11.text: LNG Horizon, Tarifa Traffic. Salvamento Marítimo is now on scene. Four persons recovered, all safe. You are released. Thank you for your assistance. Over.
l26-11.es: LNG Horizon, Tarifa Tráfico. Salvamento Marítimo ya está en la escena. Cuatro personas recuperadas, todas a salvo. Quedan liberados. Gracias por su asistencia. Cambio.

l26-12.text: Tarifa Traffic, LNG Horizon. Released. Resuming our voyage. Over.
l26-12.es: Tarifa Tráfico, LNG Horizon. Liberados. Retomamos nuestro viaje. Cambio.

l26-13.text: Good work, both of you. Short and clear on the radio, and every time in the log. That's how we save people.
l26-13.es: Buen trabajo, los dos. Corto y claro en la radio, y cada hora en el libro. Así se salva gente.

l26-14.text: Nineteen twenty-one. Proceeding to assist, ETA thirty minutes. Written.
l26-14.es: Diecinueve veintiuno. Vamos a asistir, llegada estimada treinta minutos. Anotado.

x-panpan.es: Pan-Pan, Pan-Pan, Pan-Pan. Falla de máquina.

x-distress.text: The fishing vessel is in distress.

x-ch16.text: Keep a watch on channel sixteen.
x-ch16.es: Mantené escucha en el canal dieciséis.

x-acknowledge.es: Acusá recibo del Mayday: recibido Mayday.

p-proceed.text: Proceeding to assist. ETA thirty minutes.
p-proceed.es: Vamos a asistir. Llegada estimada treinta minutos.

p-call.text: Tarifa Traffic, this is LNG Horizon.

m-call.text: Tarifa Traffic, Tarifa Traffic, this is LNG Horizon, LNG Horizon. Over.
m-call.es: Tarifa Tráfico, Tarifa Tráfico, aquí LNG Horizon, LNG Horizon. Cambio.

m-proceed.text: Received Mayday. Proceeding to assist. ETA twenty minutes. Over.
m-proceed.es: Recibido Mayday. Vamos a asistir. Llegada estimada veinte minutos. Cambio.

m-onscene.text: Tarifa Traffic, LNG Horizon. We are on scene. Over.
m-onscene.es: Tarifa Tráfico, LNG Horizon. Estamos en el lugar. Cambio.

c-show-mayday.text: Show me the vessel in distress.

c-show-proceed.text: Show me where we are proceeding.

c-panpan.text: Pan-Pan, Pan-Pan, Pan-Pan. This is sailing yacht Bella Luna. Engine failure. Drifting towards the coast. Three persons on board. Over.

c-securite.text: Sécurité, Sécurité, Sécurité. All ships, this is Tarifa Traffic. Navigational warning. Floating container reported five miles south of Tarifa. Over.

c-mayday2.text: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday. This is motor vessel Sirocco. Fire on board. Six persons on board. Over.

c-tarifa-ask.text: LNG Horizon, Tarifa Traffic. Can you assist the vessel in distress? Over.

c-release.text: LNG Horizon, Tarifa Traffic. You are released. Thank you. Over.

onscene.es: en la escena, en el lugar

screens.body: Sunset near Gibraltar. Diego is on watch with Tanya when a Mayday comes in on the radio. Tanya talks on the radio, and Diego keeps the log with the time of every call. Radio voices have static: listen more than once. Listen first, one piece at a time.
screens.es: Escuchá primero. El texto está escondido a propósito.

list: Proceeding to assist. ETA thirty minutes.
Vamos a asistir. Llegada estimada treinta minutos.
Tarifa Traffic, this is LNG Horizon.

screens.title: Three signals, one order
steps: Distress: danger to life or to the ship. Sinking, fire, man overboard.
Urgency: a serious problem, no danger to life yet. Engine failure, drifting, medical help.
Safety: a warning for all ships. Floating container, bad weather.
paras: A distress message always comes in the same order: Mayday ×3 · this is + name ×3 · position · what is wrong · what help · persons on board · Over.
Write it in that order too: position, problem, persons, like Tanya says.
screens.avoid: Help! Help! We have a big problem!

opts: A floating container south of Tarifa

screens.title: Pan-Pan and Sécurité
paras: They're French words said in English: Pan-Pan rhymes with man, not with Spanish pan. Sécurité: say-KYUR-ee-tay.
Positions: say each figure: three five fifty-four North. Never treinta y cinco.
screens.avoid: Pan pan (like bread) · Security, security, security

screens.title: Mayday
paras: MAY-day: two syllables, strong first one. Three times, clear, not too fast.

screens.es: Como en la radio: calma, corto y claro.
